newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH GROUP PAYS $3 MLN FOR BREWER LEZAJSK.
newsitem.headline: POLISH GROUP PAYS $3 MLN FOR BREWER LEZAJSK.

text.p: The Polish treasury ministry has sold a 65-percent stake in brewer Lezajsk SA to the group Towarzystwo Akcyjne Browary Polskie SA for $3 million, the ministry said in a statement on Thursday.
The statement said the group would invest 103 million zlotys from this year until 2006.

It said the group was made up of leasing firm Centralne Towarzystwo Leasingowe SA, investment house Elektromis Dom Inwestycyjny Sp zoo, publisher Przedsiebiorstwo Wydawniczo- Poligraficzne Presspo SA and two individual investors.
The new owners would maintain the current level of employment for 36 months, the statement said.
It said 15 percent of Lezajsk shares would go to employees, 15 percent to the brewer's suppliers and five percent for restitution claims.
According to 1994 data, the most recent figures available, the southeastern Polish brewer netted 90,000 zlotys on sales of 71.7 million zlotys.
The ministry had said Lezajsk badly needed a strategic investor to start the brewer's restructuring.
